Definition: from G1208; secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day:--next day.
BiblicalUsage: This word means the next day, and Luke uses it once on the voyage toward Rome, when the ship leaves Syracuse and comes to Rhegium. It is a small travel note in a long journey, the kind of detail an eyewitness remembers.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Luke's travel notes are the mark of a true account; the next day mattered because the journey mattered, and the God who kept Paul through the storm also kept the ship's course.
